about.title: Hi, I'm Hetor
paragraphs: I'm a web developer and I'm still studying programming. I like seeing a project through from start to finish.
I aim for sites that are fast, clear and easy to maintain, and I explain technical things in simple words.
The projects above are examples of what I can do. I also built this page, with Next.js and Tailwind CSS.

packages.messageUnsure: Hi Hetor, I saw your page and I'm not sure what I need yet. I'd rather explain how my business works so you can guide me. Can we talk about it?

items.q: How do I know what I need?
items.a: Start with what you want to achieve. Present your business and get contacted? A static site. Show a map, reviews or social media that already live elsewhere? API usage. Keep track of customers, orders or bookings? A database. Have someone answer for you on WhatsApp? A chatbot. If you're still unsure, pick “I don't know what I need” and tell me how your business works.
A modern way to build sites: pages are prepared in advance, so they load very fast, are more secure and cost little to maintain. When they need fresh information, they ask other services for it.

items.q: What is an API and what is it for?
items.a: It's a bridge between your site and another service. With an API I can show a Google Maps map, your reviews, the weather or your latest posts, and they update on their own without you doing anything.

To store information that belongs to your business, like customers, orders or bookings, and look it up or edit it whenever you want. If your site only shows information you don't need one; if you need to record data, it's the right tool.

items.q: What does a WhatsApp chatbot do?
items.a: It answers the most common questions for you (hours, prices, location) and can book appointments at any time. You can still talk to your customers whenever you like.

tools.title: Public, open-source tools

qr.title: QR generator
qr.text: Create QR codes with your logo, gradients and custom shapes, and download them ready to use.

svg.title: Image to SVG
svg.text: Turn an image into a vector, remove the background and recolor each area. Everything runs in your browser: your image is never uploaded to a server.

bracket.title: Bracket generator
bracket.text: Run single or double elimination, round robin or Swiss tournaments without anyone needing an account. Tweak the seeding, simulate how it would play out and report scores.

tools.intro: These are tools I built and left open for anyone: free, no account needed, and they run in your browser. The code is public, so you can use them, read them or suggest improvements on GitHub.
